about_the_game:
The bell rang, but your mind had already left the classroom. The blank pages of a lined notebook became your new reality.

"Classroom Reverie" is a 2D platformer with tight controls and fluid gameplay. It's an atmospheric, hand-drawn journey through a student's mind.

CHANGING WORLDS, CHANGING RULES

The core concept of this game is that each level has its own unique core mechanic. This isn't a single game, but a combination of six different platforming challenges. To progress, you'll need to master all six rules of the six courses:

  • Climb into the world of Literature, where words take on physical meaning.

  • In Painting, use the world's colors like a key to uncover hidden paths beyond perception.

  • In Math, push the limits of momentum by instantly rewriting the equation of your motion.

  • In Science, manipulate the states of matter and twist your surroundings; transform solids into vapors, and voids into passages.

  • In Music, solve harmony puzzles and progress as one with the rhythm of the world.

  • In Philosophy, navigate a chaos where the rules of reality are bent, logic and space are relative.

NOTHING IS APPROACHING

But this creative haven is not permanent. Every scribble you make also feeds an opposing force: Nothingness.

This is not a monster; it is the absence of everything. An unstoppable force that seeks to wipe pages clean, erase ideas, and fade ink. Your journey will culminate in a relentless pursuit against this force.

ACCEPT THE CHALLENGE

This is a game of skill, requiring tight controls and precision. For those who seek true mastery, each level contains brutally challenging secret chambers that preserve the student's lost memories.

Your mind has created this world. Can you stop it from returning everything to the void from which it began?

short_description: A hand-drawn, 2D precision platformer set in a student's notebook. Traverse six distinct subject themes, each with a unique core mechanic, in a world where your doodles come to life. Defend this world created by your mind from a threat that seeks to turn it into a void.
